description:
Following approval for demolition of No's 49-55 Boston Manor Road and erection of 12,049m2 of D1 education floor space, 849 student study rooms and ancillary accommodation, 221 key worker flats and A1/A3 floor space totalling 304m2, car parking, pedestrian and vehicle access, landscaping and associated works.
Revisions: The scheme has been reduced and altered in height and massing as follows:  The block nearest to the school has changed from one continuous building stepping down from 18, 16, 14 to 12 residential storeys, to 2 separate blocks of 12 residential storeys.  The linked block adjaent to the school access road is 17 residential storeys and the academic block next to the M4 and Boston Manor Road is risen from 7 commercial / academic storeys to 12 commercial / academic storeys over a smaller footprint.  The key worker block has been moved away from the boundary with the trading estate and has a height of 4 residential storeys rising to 8 residential storeys adjacent to the school access road.  Other amendments include: The number of student flats has reduced from 998 to 849, the number of key worker flats has reduced from 232 to 221, the number of parking spaces has increased to 111 - details submitted pursuant to condition 24 (surface water drainage) of approved planning permission reference 01217/C/P27 dated 22/12/04
